title: Bridge Mantle - Open App
meta_description: bridge mantle via the official Mantle Bridge app to move assets between Ethereum and Mantle, connect wallet, and verify the domain.
hero_h2: Move assets between Ethereum and Mantle
hero_lead: Bridge Mantle routes you to the official Mantle Bridge app for moving supported assets between Ethereum Mainnet and Mantle Network with wallet-based confirmation.
what_is: Mantle Bridge is the official Mantle Network app for moving supported assets between Ethereum Mainnet and Mantle, documented in the official bridge guide. The production action happens on app.mantle.xyz/bridge.

how.d: Use the official app URL and confirm the domain is app.mantle.xyz before connecting a wallet.
Connect your Web3 wallet, then choose the Ethereum-to-Mantle direction or the reverse withdrawal flow.
Pick a supported token, enter the amount, and review any approval request before signing.
Submit the wallet transaction, monitor status, and complete any required prove or claim step for withdrawals.

points.p: The action should happen on the Mantle-hosted app, not on copied search ads, mirrors, or lookalike domains.
Mantle is an EVM-compatible Ethereum scaling network; see the Mantle Network docs for architecture context.
Mantle Mainnet uses chain ID 5000 and MNT as the currency symbol, with transactions viewable through Mantle-compatible explorers.

faq.a: bridge mantle is search intent for using Mantle Bridge, the official app route for moving supported assets between Ethereum and Mantle Network.

faq.q: Is bridge mantle the official Mantle app?
faq.a: The official destination is app.mantle.xyz/bridge; verify that domain before connecting a wallet or approving tokens.

faq.q: How do I bridge mantle assets from Ethereum?
faq.a: Open the official app, connect your wallet, choose Ethereum as the source and Mantle as the destination, select a supported asset, then confirm in your wallet.

faq.q: Can I withdraw with bridge mantle?
faq.a: Yes. The bridge supports the reverse flow from Mantle back to Ethereum, and withdrawals can include additional prove and claim steps before funds arrive on L1.

faq.q: What should I check before using bridge mantle?
faq.a: Confirm the app domain, review token approvals, keep enough gas for the source network, and start with a small transfer if you are testing the flow.

footer_note: Not the official Mantle app; verify app.mantle.xyz before connecting. Educational content only, not financial advice.
